# Variables across function and macro definitions (engine/y). A file-scope variable stays tracked after a
# definition (5), and a function body sees the file's variables, also one set after the definition (3,

# string() writes the output argument: REPLACE (6), REGEX REPLACE (7) and JOIN (10); a REPLACE whose
# pattern names a flag removes it (8 passes). Level sets from HeliosIsa.cmake: a producer defined in mixed
# case (25), a macro called at file scope (26) and a file-scope foreach over the level set (27).
# What a body hands its caller (engine/z): an output argument set with PARENT_SCOPE (5), also when the call

# global: tools/z's return(PROPAGATE) (45) and output argument (47) reach engine/z, read first.
